annotations.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2023-01-01' AND c.country = 'Australia';
business_basis: controller.final_intent明确region.column=customer.country, value=Australia，来自allowed_user_supplements“按客户所在国家算，customer.country”与“客户居住地那边”
已确认口径：销售额采用发票粒度SUM(invoice.total)
通用约定：customer.country是客户所在地，invoice.billing_country是账单地址，两者含义不合并；本SQL按最终意图使用customer.country
issues: 原始输入“2022年澳大利亚的发票销售额”未说明住址还是账单国家，初始标注missing region_scope只能依赖程序外补充；已给定allowed_user_supplements后SQL按customer.country表达，但初始分类/模拟用户规则对地区口径覆盖不足

annotations.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS track_revenue FROM public.invoice_line il JOIN public.invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN public.track t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN public.genre g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' AND g.name = 'Rock';
business_basis: 已确认口径：曲目粒度销售额用SUM(invoice_line.unit_price * invoice_line.quantity)，并按invoice_date过滤期间，避免重复累加发票总额
